title: cadintent refusal document
description: The kernel's total rejection of a submission — nothing lands, the log is untouched. Every error in the submission is reported at once. Conformance compares refusals by their typed (code, command position, field path) triples; messages are outside the contract. Spec version 0.1.0.

RefusalCode.description: The closed v0 list of 13 typed refusal codes.

RefusalError.description: One error in the refused submission.

command.description: The 0-based position of the offending command in the submission's command list, or null for a submission-level error (e.g. stale_head, scope_violation).

path.description: A JSON Pointer to the offending field, relative to the command at 'command' (or to the submission document when 'command' is null). Empty string points at the whole target.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Outside the conformance contract.

project.description: The project the refused submission targeted.

declared_head.description: The head the submission declared, or null when the submission was too malformed to read one.

errors.description: Every error found, reported at once.
